name: Screenshot Moments
summary: Never forget to press the screenshot key again: your level ups, achievements and epic loot are captured for you.
logoPrompt: A small vintage camera with a glowing golden star reflected in its round lens

cover.tagline: Your big moments, captured on their own.
bullets: A screenshot at every level up

description: **Screenshot Moments takes a screenshot for you whenever something worth keeping happens to your character.**
- A screenshot when you reach a new level.
- A screenshot when you earn an achievement, with the achievement toast in the picture.
- A screenshot when you loot an item of Epic quality or better.
- One line in chat names the moment: the level, the achievement or the item.
- At most one screenshot every 10 seconds, and none during a loading screen.

It starts on its own. Type `/smo` or `/shotmoments` to see whether it is on and to list the commands. `/smo off` switches the screenshots off, `/smo on` brings them back, `/smo test` takes a test screenshot.
- Screenshots are saved in the game's Screenshots folder, next to the ones you take by key.
- The setting counts for all your characters.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
